name: Poaceae

children.name: Festuca
children.desc: Festuca (fescue) is a genus of flowering plants belonging to the grass family Poaceae (subfamily Pooideae).

desc: Poaceae ( poh-AY-see-e(y)e), also called Gramineae ( grə-MIN-ee-e(y)e), is a large and nearly ubiquitous family of monocotyledonous flowering plants commonly known as true grasses.
